author: genbolanos
title: Please improve
text:
This is honestly the worst app for work and needs some serious improvements ! I’ve had 7shifts and HotSchedules which are awesome and better than this.
What needs improving ?
1. Notifications: this apps doesn’t notify when our schedules are out or when someone is giving away their shift. 
2. Contacts: for some reason, the contacts went away ??? Now we can’t see people’s contact information, which is needed when we need to get ahold of them. 
3. Messaging: we wouldn’t need contacts info if we could directly message in the app! Or even have a place where we could post messages like 7shifts! 
4. Work schedule: being able to see who is or isn’t working for the day would be helpful. That way we’re not wasting our time messaging people who are already working. 
5. Time off request: apparently at work we have to write down our time off request in a notebook because this app doesn’t let us request time off!! It disappears from the system once approved ??
Please ! Improve the app and make it useful to those who use it. There are so many changes that are needed. If I had the power to change what app we use I would.

text:

•Ability to see what days I'm working and who I'm working with.
